steps.title: Open the Cockpit
steps.narration: Tapeology opens on the Cockpit — a live, simulated, or historical trading-tape viewer, with no sign-in needed.
steps.point_out: The page loads idle, inviting you to try a ticker like SIM-BUYER, with a top navigation bar showing just two links.

steps.title: Type a ticker to watch
steps.narration: Typing a simulated ticker into the ticker field is the first step to watching a live tape settle.
steps.point_out: "SIM-BUYER" now sits in the ticker field, ready to watch.

steps.title: Watch it settle to a market read
steps.narration: Clicking Watch starts the simulated tape; within a few seconds it reads which side is in control of the price action.
steps.point_out: The Tape State panel now reads "Buyer Control", with a live candlestick price chart above it.

steps.title: Switch the chart's bar size
steps.narration: The live price chart can be re-grouped into wider logical bars on the fly, without losing the live feed.
steps.point_out: The caption updates and the chart redraws with fewer, wider candles built live from the tape.

expect.text: Logical 30s bars built live from the tape.

steps.title: Stop watching
steps.narration: Stopping instantly clears the tape back to its idle state — the watch-and-stop loop still works end to end.
steps.point_out: The page returns to "No ticker watched".

steps.title: Move to the Structure page
steps.narration: One click on Structure in the top navigation opens the support/resistance analysis view, its panels ready as soon as the page loads.
steps.point_out: The Symbol/As-of/Load flow, the Case Studies table, and an Edge Report panel are all visible right away — and the Edge Report panel already reports its own honest status rather than a blank space.

steps.title: Confirm the Load form won't invent a result
steps.narration: Clicking Load before choosing a symbol or a date proves the page never makes up an answer — it simply stays put.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map stays on its plain "Choose a symbol and an as-of time" placeholder — no price level appears from an empty form.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time

steps.title: Enter a symbol to study
steps.narration: Loading Structure starts with a symbol and a point in time.
steps.point_out: "AAPL" now sits in the Symbol field.

steps.title: Enter the as-of date
steps.narration: The as-of field pins the exact moment the levels and chart are computed for.
steps.point_out: The as-of field now reads the chosen date and time.

steps.title: Load AAPL's tradable map
steps.narration: Loading a symbol and a date renders its candlestick chart together with a shaded support/resistance wall band.
steps.point_out: The chart shows AAPL's candles with a tradable wall band around 300.11 to 302.2, and a table below it lists that band's details.

steps.title: Open a case-study drill-in
steps.narration: Clicking any row in the Case Studies table opens a detailed drill-in for that specific event.
steps.point_out: The drill-in repeats the row's band and reaction, then shows either a recorded tape timeline or the honest note that no tape was recorded for that event.

steps.title: Back to the Cockpit, navigation still intact
steps.narration: Clicking back through the same two-item navigation confirms both pages still connect correctly, with nothing extra ever added.
steps.point_out: The nav bar shows only "Cockpit" and "Structure" — exactly the same two links as at the very start of this tour.
